The soleplate is facing the camera, showing a metallic surface with steam holes and a red circular sticker. The body is white plastic with blue accents near the handle area. A power cord is visible extending from the rear.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The red sticker contains text that appears nonsensical or illegible upon close inspection. The characters do not form recognizable words or standard safety symbols, suggesting AI hallucination of text details.

The metallic texture lacks the fine linear brushing or uniform polish often seen on real irons. Some areas around the steam holes appear slightly 'muddy' or overly smooth, lacking realistic micro-scratches or wear.
The connection between the power cord and the iron body is slightly ambiguous and soft-focused, lacking a clear strain relief or plug housing structure, appearing somewhat fused into the plastic.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of iron and rule out misclassification as similar appliances like kettles or heaters.
To assess overall sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect subtle generative artifacts in textures and reflections.
To verify the structural integrity of the plastic molding and ensure the soleplate is correctly attached without floating elements.
To specifically analyze the illegible text on the red sticker, confirming if it is gibberish or just low-resolution blur.

focus_areas: Legibility and semantic correctness of text on the red sticker
Realism of metallic reflections and steam hole geometry
Structural plausibility of the power cord attachment
Consistency of plastic molding seams and edges
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the red sticker on the soleplate. Real irons often have safety warnings or brand logos; AI often generates pseudo-text. Evaluate if the text is merely blurry or structurally nonsensical. Also, check if the steam holes are uniformly shaped and punched through the metal, or if they look like painted dots or melted deformities.
